claimText:
Fix Forensics 25 Module 1 YouTube videos rendering blank by removing locked-card CSS blur that prevents cross-origin iframe painting, then export and deploy Forensics 25.

# STAX Codex Report

## STAX acknowledgement
STAX_ACK turn_2026-05-20T15-05-26-273Z_ab55 cc3be9c8 2b12dd93

## Objective
Fix Forensics 25 Module 1 YouTube videos that were still showing as blank boxes by removing the locked-card blur effect that can prevent cross-origin YouTube iframes from painting, then export and deploy Forensics 25.

## Files changed
- `projects/forensicstudiesoption2/workspace/content/module-index.css`
- `projects/forensicstudiesoption2/exports/google-hosted/**`
- `.stax/task.md`
- `.stax/codex-report.md`
- `docs/ops/ACTIVE_HANDOFF.md`

## Tests added
None. No automated tests were run for this visual/CSS-only course rendering fix.

## Commands run
- Read `.stax/turn-contract.json`, `.stax/status.json`, `.stax/next-codex-prompt.md`: exit 0.
- Read `docs/ops/FAST_PATHS.md` and `docs/ops/ACTIVE_HANDOFF.md`: exit 0.
- Search Forensics 25 workspace/export content for YouTube/video evidence: exit 1 because PowerShell path globs were invalid for two optional paths, but the command still returned relevant Module 1 matches before the path errors.
- Search Forensics 25 export content for YouTube/video evidence: exit 1 because optional glob paths were invalid.
- Inspect Forensics 25 `module-index.css` for iframe, locked-card, and filter rules: exit 0.
- Live fetch check for Forensics 25 Module 1 page and both YouTube embed endpoints: exit 0.
- Search workspace/export Module 1 pages for YouTube iframe sources: one malformed quoting command failed, then targeted search succeeded with exit 0.
- Update `projects/forensicstudiesoption2/workspace/content/module-index.css`: exit 0.
- `npm.cmd run export:google-hosted -- --project forensicstudiesoption2`: exit 0.
- `npm.cmd run deploy:google-hosted -- --project forensicstudiesoption2`: exit 0.
- Live fetch check for `https://forensics25.web.app/content/chapter-1/index.html` and `https://forensics25.web.app/content/module-index.css`: exit 0.

## Command output summary with exit codes
- Before the CSS fix, Module 1 live page returned HTTP 200 and contained both YouTube embed IDs: `Ys09c9lANjI` and `jcypaqcKesU`.
- Both YouTube embed endpoints returned HTTP 200 and did not return unavailable text in the fetched HTML.
- CSS inspection found `.lesson-card.is-locked .lesson-body` using `filter: blur(3px)` plus `pointer-events: none`.
- Export completed: `387 file(s), 10 tracked storage key(s)`.
- Deploy completed to Firebase Hosting site `forensics25`, live URL `https://forensics25.web.app`.
- Post-deploy live chapter fetch returned HTTP 200 with both Module 1 YouTube embeds still present.
- Post-deploy live CSS fetch returned HTTP 200 with `filter: blur(3px)` absent and `opacity: 0.72` present.

## What is verified
- The two Module 1 YouTube iframes are present in the workspace, exported bundle, and live page.
- The external YouTube embed pages for both Module 1 videos were reachable from this environment with HTTP 200.
- The likely blanking rule, `filter: blur(3px)` on locked lesson bodies, was removed from the Forensics 25 module CSS.
- The lock behavior still exists through lowered opacity and disabled pointer events instead of blur.
- The fixed Forensics 25 bundle was exported and deployed live.

## What is weak/provisional
- No browser visual screenshot was collected after deploy.
- No automated test was run.
- This confirms deployed HTML/CSS state and YouTube endpoint reachability, but not pixel-level playback in the user's browser/network.

## What is unverified
- Whether the user's browser now paints the YouTube thumbnails/players after a hard refresh.
- Whether the school network or browser extensions block YouTube embeds independently of the course CSS.
- Whether STAX will accept without fresh visual proof.

## Risks
- Locked cards now show their content dimmed instead of blurred. This is intentional because blur can break cross-origin iframe painting.
- Videos remain non-interactive while locked because pointer events are still disabled on locked lesson bodies.
- Firebase Hosting now has one additional live release for `forensics25`.

## One next action
Hard-refresh `https://forensics25.web.app/content/chapter-1/index.html` and confirm Module 1 video boxes now show the YouTube player/thumbnail; if they are still blank, capture browser console/network proof to distinguish CSS from local YouTube blocking.
